description: PostgreSQL 17 golden-anchor and psql-probe infrastructure smoke (issue #117): proves the postgres17 digest-locked anchor, psql fixture execution, sqlstate error classification, feature-rule isolation, and live metadata-aware audit over TCP — the same contract the mysql/tidb anchors carry, scoped to the postgresql manifest scope.

verify.sql: SELECT schema_name FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name='golden'

ddl_steps.name: create table
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE golden.probe (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, email text NOT NULL)

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE table_schema='golden' AND table_name='probe' AND constraint_type='PRIMARY KEY'

ddl_steps.name: alter add array column
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE golden.probe ADD COLUMN tags text[]

verify.sql: SELECT data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='golden' AND table_name='probe' AND column_name='tags'
SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name='golden'

post_state_check.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name='golden'

teardown.sql: DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS golden CASCADE
